content.comment_body: Hello Experts, 2. Is the PT1000 sensor compatible with the [product_name] AM2 Pt100 module? I recall seeing information about this, but I am unable to locate it in the manuals now. Thank you! Split from a thread discussing grounding connections behind AM2 / AM2 Pt100 modules and their attachment to DIN rails.

Hi, 2. A PT1000 sensor is not compatible with the [product_name] AM2 PT100 module. There is an updated module called AM2 RTD, which supports both PT100 and PT1000 sensors. Hope this clarifies your doubt.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clarity on whether a PT1000 sensor works with the [product_name] AM2 PT100 module. The discussion shows users struggle to find clear documentation, with uncertainty about sensor compatibility in manuals. Another user clarifies the incompatibility and points out an alternative module, reflecting gaps and ambiguities in the available official resources.
